test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Ram has 15 toffees, 10 biscuits and 5 chocolates. He gave one-third toffees to Sohan and half of the biscuits to Mohan. Sohan exchanged all toffees with Mohan against two biscuits. Mohan gave the remaining biscuits to Ram to get two chocolates. How many biscuits will be left with Ram, if he gives half of the biscuits, in the end, to Sohan?
solution:
**Given**

Number of toffees Ram has = 15

Number of biscuit Ram has = 10

Number of chocolates Ram has = 5

**Calculation**

Number of toffees given to Sohan = (1/3) × 15

⇒ 5

Number of biscuit given to Mohan = (1/2) × 10

⇒ 5

Number of biscuit left with Ram = 10 - 5

⇒ 5

Sohan gives all toffees to Mohan and get two biscuit.

Now, Number of biscuit Sohan has = 2

Number of toffess Sohan has = 0

Number of biscuit Mohan has = 5 - 2

⇒ 3

Number of biscuit given by Mohan to Ram = 3

Now, Ram has number of biscuit = 5 + 3

⇒ 8

Ram give half of the biscuit to Sohan = (1/2) × 8

⇒ 4

Biscuit left with Ram = 8 - 4

⇒ 4

**∴ 4 biscuit will be left with Ram, if he gives half of the biscuits, in the end, to Sohan.**
